purpose: A submitted claim moves through PHC Staff review, Accounts & Audit verification, Approving Authority sanction, and Accounts & Audit payment in the defined order.
preconditions: An eligible employee has submitted a claim in Submitted state.
action_or_input: Advance the claim through each workflow stage in the defined forward order.
expected_result: The claim progresses sequentially: Submitted -> Pending PHC Review -> Pending Accounts Verification -> Pending Sanction -> Approved for Payment -> Reimbursed.

purpose: When the Approving Authority approves the sanction, the claim becomes Approved for Payment and is routed to Accounts & Audit.
preconditions: A verified claim is in Pending Sanction state.
action_or_input: The Approving Authority selects Approve for the sanction.
expected_result: The claim state becomes Approved for Payment and is routed to Accounts & Audit.

purpose: When the Approving Authority rejects the sanction, the claim state becomes Rejected and the current progression ends.
preconditions: A verified claim is in Pending Sanction state.
action_or_input: The Approving Authority selects Reject for the sanction.
expected_result: The claim state becomes Rejected and the current reimbursement progression ends.

purpose: Rejection at sanction is terminal; any later application must be submitted as a new claim.
preconditions: A claim has been Rejected at sanction.
action_or_input: The employee attempts to modify or reopen the rejected claim.
expected_result: The rejected claim is not modified or reopened; a new claim must be submitted.

purpose: PHC Staff creates and submits a procurement requisition routed to the Approving Authority.
preconditions: PHC Staff has created a requisition with items and quantities.
expected_result: The requisition is created in Pending Approval state and routed to the Approving Authority.

purpose: When the Approving Authority approves a requisition, the state becomes Approved and the originator is notified.
preconditions: A requisition is in Pending Approval state.
expected_result: The requisition state becomes Approved and the originator is notified.

purpose: When the Approving Authority rejects a requisition, the state becomes Rejected and the workflow ends.
preconditions: A requisition is in Pending Approval state.
expected_result: The requisition state becomes Rejected and the requisition workflow ends.

purpose: PHC Staff marks an approved requisition Fulfilled after supplies are delivered; fulfillment does not auto-post stock.
preconditions: A requisition is Approved and supplies are delivered.
action_or_input: PHC Staff marks the requisition Fulfilled.
expected_result: The requisition state becomes Fulfilled and the workflow is closed; stock is not automatically updated.
